question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The detective’s _______________ examination of the crime scene revealed crucial evidence that others had missed.
solution:
Below is the solution to your question in the requested HTML format:

The correct answer is '**thorough**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**thorough**" means detailed and comprehensive, leaving no aspect unnoticed.
 
• The detective's detailed examination uncovered crucial evidence that others had missed, highlighting thoroughness.
